title: Tropical Fish Are Poisonous!│熱帶魚有毒！
description: Don’t eat tropical fish, it will cause poisoning!│不要吃熱帶魚，會中毒！
body:
**⚠️ This data pack requires the server-side mod [Item Components](https://modrinth.com/mod/item-components).│該資料包需要伺服器端模組[物品組件](https://modrinth.com/mod/item-components)。 ⚠️**
# Introduce│介紹
Tropical fish are poisonous in real life, but why can we eat them without any scruples in Minecraft? Eating a tropical fish will cause hunger for 30 seconds and poison for 5 seconds, so it's best to feed the tropical fish to the axolotl!│現實中的熱帶魚是有毒的，但是在Minecraft中為甚麼我們卻能肆無忌憚的吃熱帶魚？現在，吃了熱帶魚會受到30秒飢餓和5秒中毒，所以還是將熱帶魚餵給美西螈吧！
